_about: Channel vocabulary. Three letter-families only: K (K-Deck, digital fireground), A (analog fireground), B (Mesa mutual-aid). No C-J — the system goes A, B, then K. Channel recognition is family + number. Sound-alike errors (e.g. 'Way N' heard for 'A N') are NOT channels — they live in asr_corrections.json and are fixed BEFORE channel matching.

1.note: K-Deck 1 is the DISPATCH channel — no fireground ops occur here. This is the channel monitored for dispatches. A dispatch on K-Deck 1 is expected; fireground traffic on it would be anomalous.

families.description: Analog fireground channels. Optional 'Fire Channel' prefix, sometimes spoken sometimes not, always followed by an A-channel.
Mesa mutual-aid channels. Mesa runs its own dispatch center, outside Phoenix Regional.
families.emits_parsed_note: When a B-channel matches, set parsed.mutual_aid = 'Mesa' — a B-channel signals the incident involves an external agency, not just a channel value.

_matching_note: Fix the existing duplication: K-Deck normalization currently exists in BOTH a REPLACEMENTS rule and CHAN_RE. Consolidate to one path. Channel matching runs AFTER asr_corrections (so 'Way 6' -> 'A 6' is already fixed).
